Who We Are

Trusted with your car since 2003

For over twenty years, LG2 Autostation has been providing excellent service — growing into the largest carwash and auto detailing chain in the Philippines, with 19 branches today.

From a quick car wash to ceramic coating and PPF, every branch is built to keep your car looking its best.

🏁 Est. 2003
📍 19 Branches
